.testimonialsUnverified.quote: SecuEdge transformed our security posture while maintaining our attorneys' ability to work efficiently. Their legal-specific solutions address the unique challenges our firm faces with client confidentiality and regulatory requirements.

SecuEdge provided us with a unified security platform that protects client confidentiality across all our global offices while making it easier for our attorneys to collaborate securely. The matter-based controls and ethical walls are exactly what a multinational law firm needs.

As a corporate legal department handling high-value IP and sensitive litigation, we needed security that understood our specific requirements. SecuEdge's platform gives us granular control over document access while making it simple to collaborate with our outside counsel securely.

.faqs[faq-integration].q: How does SecuEdge integrate with our existing legal practice management software?
.faqs[faq-integration].a: SecuEdge provides seamless integration with major legal practice management systems including Clio, iManage, NetDocuments, ProLaw, and others. Our integration approach allows security controls to leverage existing matter management data, minimizing duplicate data entry and ensuring consistent security across all firm systems while preserving the attorney workflows you already have in place.
